milestones.title: Phase 0 — Foundation
milestones.description: A reliable, trustworthy site skeleton: green deploys, a license, supply-chain hygiene, and this planning infrastructure.

milestones.title: Phase 1 — Content completeness
milestones.description: Every content pillar (architectures, metrics, awards, community, events, blog) is accurate, current, and self-maintaining.

milestones.title: Phase 2 — Community and governance
milestones.description: The project can outlive any single maintainer.

milestones.title: Phase 3 — Ecosystem integration
milestones.description: endusers.cncf.io becomes the authoritative end-user destination.

milestones.title: Launch
milestones.description: Cross-cutting launch milestone: the site is announced when every readiness gate in LAUNCH.md is satisfied, not on a calendar date.
